learningObjectives: Identify the main tools and panels used in Figma.
Create and organize basic frames, layers, and objects.
Apply fundamental layout and alignment tools in a design file.

activities.title: Figma Workspace Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore the main areas of the Figma workspace.

content.concept: Figma organizes design work through the toolbar, canvas, layers panel, properties panel, assets, and reusable resources.
content.tip: Explore each workspace area to understand what type of task it supports.

descriptions: Contains tools for selecting, drawing, creating frames, text, and shapes.
Shows the hierarchy of objects and layers.
Main area where designs are created and arranged.
Displays properties such as size, position, typography, and fills.
Provides access to reusable components and assets.
Organizes different sections of a Figma file.

activities.title: Tool Matcher
activities.instruction: Match each design task with the appropriate Figma tool.

content.concept: Figma tools support tasks such as selecting, drawing shapes, creating frames, adding text, and arranging objects.
content.tip: Identify the user's intended design operation before selecting the tool.

choices: Frame Tool — Create a screen or layout container
Move Tool — Select and reposition objects
Pen Tool — Create custom vector paths
config.answer: Frame Tool — Create a screen or layout container

activities.title: Frame Builder
activities.instruction: Build the basic structure of a mobile application screen.

content.concept: Frames define screen boundaries and containers and provide the foundation for structured interface layouts.
content.tip: Start with the frame and organize the major regions inside it.

activities.title: Layer Organization Lab
activities.instruction: Arrange the layers into a logical hierarchy.

content.concept: Clear layer organization makes designs easier to understand, edit, collaborate on, and maintain.
content.tip: Group related objects and use meaningful names for important layers.
